scope: Execution model validation before any new strategy selection. No new strategy optimization or promotion on previously seen price-only results.
directions: weth_to_stable with input amount derived from contemporaneous spot value, not roundtrip PnL
primary_exact_quote_method: Read-only eth_call to official factory/pool/QuoterV2 at explicit historical block; validate chain, factory, pool, tokens, decimals, fee, block hash and timestamp. No state overrides, private keys, approvals, sends or wallet balances.
local_model: Independent integer Q96 constant-active-liquidity step, compare only where no initialized tick was crossed. Reject unsupported crossing; no claim of a complete multi-tick routing engine.
independent_validation: At most first three Swap logs in a fixed bounded interval around each timestamp for each EVM pool. Compare exact positive input and negative output against historical Quoter only when the target is the first pool log in its block, avoiding earlier same-block pool changes. All skips and mismatches retained. Maximum 18 candidate other-user swaps.

acceptance.scope_limit: Numerical model validation does not prove transaction inclusion, gas for a new funded route, MEV safety, permission to use a service, or a trading edge. A failed coverage gate prevents overall execution qualification.

gas: Observed historical receipt totals are separate from quoter internal gas. Base L1/operator components explicitly required; Nitro component not counted twice. USD conversion is a contemporaneous stablecoin-peg proxy. Receipt from another user is not exact gas of a hypothetical 10-25 dollar order. Missing full route cost remains UNKNOWN.
solana: Decode current finalized known Whirlpool account identity, token mints, fee and active liquidity only if schema verified. Current getAccountInfo is not historical account state. No historical quote claim without historical tick arrays and account state.
scenario_limits: Quote friction and contemporaneous observed gas can inform explicitly conditional break-even scenarios, never fabricate calendar return or a strategy backtest from sparse quote samples.

bounded_access.rate_limit: Pace reads and stop/back off on 429; never evade denied service or use paid credentials.

fallback: If public historical RPC is unavailable, retain failures and try one officially documented alternative read-only source. Do not silently substitute latest state or candle price for historical quotes.
stopping_rule: One bounded execution-evidence round. If data/model/execution evidence is incomplete, record NO VALIDATED TRADING EDGE FOUND, stop additional strategy runs and recommend a concrete data route. No continuous paper operation unless a separately validated strategy and actual runtime exist.
preservation: Original 128 tests, runtime modules, strategies and all prior reports remain unchanged. Work in independent branch; keep PR2 unchanged and use a stacked PR to avoid duplicate integration.
